capabilities: : Render live HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
extras: Executes code in an isolated Shadow DOM; external scripts are not fetched or run.
problem: Users need a way to display complex, styled, or interactive web content directly inside their Markdown notes without relying on external files or complex rendering tools.
summary: Renders live HTML, CSS, and JavaScript directly within Obsidian notes using custom code fences, isolating each block in its own Shadow DOM.
